items.question: master's program scholarships
items.answer:
Master's scholarships `provide non-repayable funding for postgraduate study, often based on academic merit, financial need, or specific eligibility criteria` . Top options for 2026/27 include the £15,000 [UCL Global Master's Scholarship](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/scholarships/ucl-global-masters-scholarship) for international students, and [Commonwealth Master's Scholarships](https://www.qmul.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/funding_masters/) for students from developing nations. Apply early, often after securing a course offer, via university websites or specialized search engines.[[1]](https://www.prospects.ac.uk/postgraduate-study/funding-postgraduate-study/scholarships-and-bursaries/)[[2]](https://www.findamasters.com/guides/scholarships)[[3]](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/scholarships/ucl-global-masters-scholarship#:~:text=The%20UCL%20Global%20Master's%20Scholarship%20is%20a,in%202026/27%20*%20Attend%20UCL%20in%20person)[[4]](https://www.qmul.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/funding_masters/)[[5]](https://yocket.com/blog/scholarships-for-ms-in-uk#:~:text=You%20can%20get%20university-provided%20scholarships%20for%20MS,and%20other%20scholarships%20provided%20for%20Indian%20students.)

**Key UK Master's Scholarship Types & Examples** 

- **University-Specific Scholarships:** 
	- **UCL Global Master's Scholarship:** £15,000 for international students.
	- **[University of Nottingham Developing Solutions Scholarship](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/funding/developing-solutions-masters-scholarship):** Focuses on contributing to home country challenges.
	- **[SOAS Academic Excellence Scholarship](https://www.soas.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-bursaries-and-awards/postgraduate-taught-scholarships):** Available for both UK and international students.
	- **[Aston University Alan and Nester Ferguson Scholarship](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PotDAXZC674):** Covers full tuition for specific medical fields.
- **Government & International Scholarships:** 
	- **Commonwealth Master's Scholarships:** For citizens of developing Commonwealth countries.
	- **[Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships](https://www.acu.ac.uk/funding-opportunities/for-students/scholarships/queen-elizabeth-commonwealth-scholarships/):** Focus on research and development-related master's programs.
- **Subject/Targeted Scholarships:** 
	- **[LSHTM MSc Scholarships](https://www.lshtm.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/funding-scholarships/masters-funding):** Includes GSK Scholarships for Future Health Leaders.
	- **[Frank Palmer Award (Reading)](https://www.reading.ac.uk/ready-to-study/study/fees-and-funding/masters-scholarships):** For Applied Linguistics students.[[1]](https://www.reading.ac.uk/ready-to-study/study/fees-and-funding/masters-scholarships)[[2]](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/scholarships/ucl-global-masters-scholarship#:~:text=The%20UCL%20Global%20Master's%20Scholarship%20is%20a,in%202026/27%20*%20Attend%20UCL%20in%20person)[[3]](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/funding/developing-solutions-masters-scholarship)[[4]](https://www.soas.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-bursaries-and-awards/postgraduate-taught-scholarships#:~:text=Table_title:%20P%20a%20r%20t%20i%20a,Country/Nationality:%20Overseas%20students%20%7C%20Status:%20Open%20%7C)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PotDAXZC674&t=126)[[6]](https://www.qmul.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/funding_masters/)[[7]](https://www.acu.ac.uk/funding-opportunities/for-students/scholarships/queen-elizabeth-commonwealth-scholarships/)[[8]](https://www.lshtm.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/funding-scholarships/masters-funding#:~:text=Table_title:%20Masters%20%28MSc%29%20funding%20and%20scholarships%20Table_content:,%7C%20Application%20deadline:%2019%20February%202026%20%7C)

**How to Secure Funding** 

- **Check Eligibility Early:** Many scholarships require you to hold an offer for a Master's course before applying.
- **Submit Separately:** While some are automatic, others (like the Developing Solutions Scholarship ) require separate applications outlining your vision and academic merit.
- **Prepare Documentation:** Be ready to provide a 300-500 word statement outlining your academic background, career goals, and how the scholarship fits your plan.[[1]](https://www.prospects.ac.uk/postgraduate-study/funding-postgraduate-study/scholarships-and-bursaries/)[[2]](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/funding/developing-solutions-masters-scholarship)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PotDAXZC674&t=126)[[4]](https://www.ntu.ac.uk/course/education/pg/education-with-specialist-pathways#:~:text=A%20300-500%20word%20statement%20on:%20Explain%20why,the%20word%20count%20will%20not%20be%20considered.)

**Other Funding Sources** 

- **UK Postgraduate Master's Loan:** Up to £13,206 for 2026/27, available to UK nationals and residents.
- **[Bursaries](https://www.findamasters.com/guides/scholarships):** Often smaller grants based on financial need.
- **Employer Sponsorship:** Funding provided by a company for employee professional development.[[1]](https://www.findamasters.com/guides/scholarships)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/funding-for-postgraduate-study)[[3]](https://www.gov.uk/masters-loan/eligibility#:~:text=You%20can%20apply%20for%20the%20Postgraduate%20Master's,can%20stay.%20you%20normally%20live%20in%20England.)[[4]](https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/finding-funding-for-a-masters-degree/#:~:text=Some%20organisations%20offer%20financial%20support%20or%20sponsorship,ask%20an%20employer%20to%20fund%20your%20education.)[[5]](https://www.lse.ac.uk/Cities/education/emc/Fees-Funding#:~:text=If%20you're%20currently%20employed%2C%20we%20encourage%20you,Sponsorship%20%29%20particularly%20well-suited%20for%20employer%20sponsorship.)

items.question: master scholarships
items.answer:
Master's scholarships `provide non-repayable funding for postgraduate study, often based on academic merit, financial need, or specific eligibility criteria` . Top options for 2026/27 include the £15,000 [UCL Global Master's Scholarship](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/scholarships/ucl-global-masters-scholarship) for international students, and [Commonwealth Master's Scholarships](https://www.qmul.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/funding_masters/) for students from developing nations. Apply early, often after securing a course offer, via university websites or specialized search engines.[[1]](https://www.prospects.ac.uk/postgraduate-study/funding-postgraduate-study/scholarships-and-bursaries/)[[2]](https://www.findamasters.com/guides/scholarships)[[3]](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/scholarships/ucl-global-masters-scholarship#:~:text=The%20UCL%20Global%20Master's%20Scholarship%20is%20a,in%202026/27%20*%20Attend%20UCL%20in%20person)[[4]](https://www.qmul.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/funding_masters/)[[5]](https://yocket.com/blog/scholarships-for-ms-in-uk#:~:text=You%20can%20get%20university-provided%20scholarships%20for%20MS,and%20other%20scholarships%20provided%20for%20Indian%20students.)

**Key UK Master's Scholarship Types & Examples** 

- **University-Specific Scholarships:** 
	- **UCL Global Master's Scholarship:** £15,000 for international students.
	- **[University of Nottingham Developing Solutions Scholarship](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/funding/developing-solutions-masters-scholarship):** Focuses on contributing to home country challenges.
	- **[SOAS Academic Excellence Scholarship](https://www.soas.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-bursaries-and-awards/postgraduate-taught-scholarships):** Available for both UK and international students.
	- **[Aston University Alan and Nester Ferguson Scholarship](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PotDAXZC674):** Covers full tuition for specific medical fields.
- **Government & International Scholarships:** 
	- **Commonwealth Master's Scholarships:** For citizens of developing Commonwealth countries.
	- **[Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships](https://www.acu.ac.uk/funding-opportunities/for-students/scholarships/queen-elizabeth-commonwealth-scholarships/):** Focus on research and development-related master's programs.
- **Subject/Targeted Scholarships:** 
	- **[LSHTM MSc Scholarships](https://www.lshtm.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/funding-scholarships/masters-funding):** Includes GSK Scholarships for Future Health Leaders.
	- **[Frank Palmer Award (Reading)](https://www.reading.ac.uk/ready-to-study/study/fees-and-funding/masters-scholarships):** For Applied Linguistics students.[[1]](https://www.reading.ac.uk/ready-to-study/study/fees-and-funding/masters-scholarships)[[2]](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/scholarships/ucl-global-masters-scholarship#:~:text=The%20UCL%20Global%20Master's%20Scholarship%20is%20a,in%202026/27%20*%20Attend%20UCL%20in%20person)[[3]](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/funding/developing-solutions-masters-scholarship)[[4]](https://www.soas.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-bursaries-and-awards/postgraduate-taught-scholarships#:~:text=Table_title:%20P%20a%20r%20t%20i%20a,Country/Nationality:%20Overseas%20students%20%7C%20Status:%20Open%20%7C)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PotDAXZC674&t=126)[[6]](https://www.qmul.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/funding_masters/)[[7]](https://www.acu.ac.uk/funding-opportunities/for-students/scholarships/queen-elizabeth-commonwealth-scholarships/)[[8]](https://www.lshtm.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/funding-scholarships/masters-funding#:~:text=Table_title:%20Masters%20%28MSc%29%20funding%20and%20scholarships%20Table_content:,%7C%20Application%20deadline:%2019%20February%202026%20%7C)

**How to Secure Funding** 

- **Check Eligibility Early:** Many scholarships require you to hold an offer for a Master's course before applying.
- **Submit Separately:** While some are automatic, others (like the Developing Solutions Scholarship ) require separate applications outlining your vision and academic merit.
- **Prepare Documentation:** Be ready to provide a 300-500 word statement outlining your academic background, career goals, and how the scholarship fits your plan.[[1]](https://www.prospects.ac.uk/postgraduate-study/funding-postgraduate-study/scholarships-and-bursaries/)[[2]](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/funding/developing-solutions-masters-scholarship)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PotDAXZC674&t=126)[[4]](https://www.ntu.ac.uk/course/education/pg/education-with-specialist-pathways#:~:text=A%20300-500%20word%20statement%20on:%20Explain%20why,the%20word%20count%20will%20not%20be%20considered.)

**Other Funding Sources** 

- **UK Postgraduate Master's Loan:** Up to £13,206 for 2026/27, available to UK nationals and residents.
- **[Bursaries](https://www.findamasters.com/guides/scholarships):** Often smaller grants based on financial need.
- **Employer Sponsorship:** Funding provided by a company for employee professional development.[[1]](https://www.findamasters.com/guides/scholarships)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/funding-for-postgraduate-study)[[3]](https://www.gov.uk/masters-loan/eligibility#:~:text=You%20can%20apply%20for%20the%20Postgraduate%20Master's,can%20stay.%20you%20normally%20live%20in%20England.)[[4]](https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/finding-funding-for-a-masters-degree/#:~:text=Some%20organisations%20offer%20financial%20support%20or%20sponsorship,ask%20an%20employer%20to%20fund%20your%20education.)[[5]](https://www.lse.ac.uk/Cities/education/emc/Fees-Funding#:~:text=If%20you're%20currently%20employed%2C%20we%20encourage%20you,Sponsorship%20%29%20particularly%20well-suited%20for%20employer%20sponsorship.)

A commercial property loan is `a secured loan used by businesses to buy, refinance, or develop commercial premises like offices, retail spaces, or industrial units` . Typically, these loans offer terms of 1 to 30 years, often with 65-75% Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios, allowing businesses to spread costs or invest in property.[[1]](https://www.british-business-bank.co.uk/business-guidance/guidance-articles/finance/how-to-finance-a-commercial-property-purchase)[[2]](https://www.natwest.com/business/loans-and-finance/commercial-mortgage.html#:~:text=What%20is%20a%20Commercial%20Mortgage?%20A%20commercial,commercial%20property%20with%20the%20flexibility%20of%20repayments.)[[3]](https://togethermoney.com/commercial-mortgages)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PKe7_9VlNtU&t=233)[[5]](https://business.bankofscotland.co.uk/mortgages.html)

**Key Aspects of Commercial Property Loans** 

- **Types of Property:** Covered properties include offices, industrial units, retail, and mixed-use, often involving [Together Money's semi-commercial mortgages](https://togethermoney.com/commercial-mortgages) for properties with both residential and commercial elements.
- **Purpose:** Used for buying, refurbishing, or refinancing existing premises, as outlined by [Barclays](https://www.barclays.co.uk/business-banking/borrow/commercial-mortgages/).
- **Loan-to-Value (LTV):** Generally 65% to 75% for experienced owners, with [first-time investors](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PKe7_9VlNtU) often needing to budget for a 65% LTV, though some lenders offer up to 100% with additional security.
- **Interest Rates:** These can be fixed or variable, frequently higher than residential mortgages due to higher lender risk.
- **Repayment Structure:** Options include capital & interest or interest-only repayments, with terms up to 25 or 30 years.[[1]](https://www.british-business-bank.co.uk/business-guidance/guidance-articles/finance/how-to-finance-a-commercial-property-purchase)[[2]](https://togethermoney.com/commercial-mortgages)[[3]](https://business.bankofscotland.co.uk/mortgages.html)[[4]](https://www.barclays.co.uk/business-banking/borrow/commercial-mortgages/#:~:text=A%20commercial%20mortgage%20is%20a%20type%20of,Buying%20motor%20vehicles%2C%20machinery%20and%20other%20equipment)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PKe7_9VlNtU&t=233)[[6]](https://www.rbs.co.uk/business/loans-and-finance/commercial-mortgage.html)[[7]](https://www.santander.co.uk/corporate/solutions/finance/commercial-mortgage)

**How to Apply** 

1. **Broker Consultation:** Many, including [Atom bank](https://www.atombank.co.uk/business-loans/commercial-mortgages/) , recommend speaking to an independent broker to assess needs.
2. **Documentation:** Prepare business plans, proof of income, and details of the property.
3. **Valuation:** The lender will conduct a valuation on the security property.
4. **Approval & Terms:** The lender will provide a decision based on credit history and the property's value.[[1]](https://developmentbank.wales/get-business-finance/property-development-loans/commercial-property-loans)[[2]](https://www.atombank.co.uk/business-loans/commercial-mortgages/)[[3]](https://togethermoney.com/commercial-mortgages)

**Alternatives & Considerations** 

- **Development Finance:** For building projects, such as those covered by the [Development Bank of Wales](https://developmentbank.wales/get-business-finance/property-development-loans/commercial-property-loans) , specialist funding is available.
- **Rates:** Commercial interest rates often vary from 7.5% to 18% per annum.
- **Risk:** As a secured loan, the property may be repossessed if repayments are not made.[[1]](https://developmentbank.wales/get-business-finance/property-development-loans/commercial-property-loans)[[2]](https://www.bajajfinserv.in/commercial-property-loan-interest-rates#:~:text=Table_title:%20Commercial%20property%20interest%20rates%20Table_content:%20header:,of%20Interest%29%20%28Floating%20rate%20of%20interest%29%20%7C)[[3]](https://www.natwest.com/business/loans-and-finance/commercial-buy-to-let-mortgages.html)

A commercial property loan is `a secured loan used by businesses to buy, refinance, or develop commercial premises like offices, retail spaces, or industrial units` . Typically, these loans offer terms of 1 to 30 years, often with 65-75% Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios, allowing businesses to spread costs or invest in property.[[1]](https://www.british-business-bank.co.uk/business-guidance/guidance-articles/finance/how-to-finance-a-commercial-property-purchase)[[2]](https://www.natwest.com/business/loans-and-finance/commercial-mortgage.html#:~:text=What%20is%20a%20Commercial%20Mortgage?%20A%20commercial,commercial%20property%20with%20the%20flexibility%20of%20repayments.)[[3]](https://togethermoney.com/commercial-mortgages)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PKe7_9VlNtU&t=233)[[5]](https://business.bankofscotland.co.uk/mortgages.html)

**Key Aspects of Commercial Property Loans** 

- **Types of Property:** Covered properties include offices, industrial units, retail, and mixed-use, often involving [Together Money's semi-commercial mortgages](https://togethermoney.com/commercial-mortgages) for properties with both residential and commercial elements.
- **Purpose:** Used for buying, refurbishing, or refinancing existing premises, as outlined by [Barclays](https://www.barclays.co.uk/business-banking/borrow/commercial-mortgages/).
- **Loan-to-Value (LTV):** Generally 65% to 75% for experienced owners, with [first-time investors](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PKe7_9VlNtU) often needing to budget for a 65% LTV, though some lenders offer up to 100% with additional security.
- **Interest Rates:** These can be fixed or variable, frequently higher than residential mortgages due to higher lender risk.
- **Repayment Structure:** Options include capital & interest or interest-only repayments, with terms up to 25 or 30 years.[[1]](https://www.british-business-bank.co.uk/business-guidance/guidance-articles/finance/how-to-finance-a-commercial-property-purchase)[[2]](https://togethermoney.com/commercial-mortgages)[[3]](https://business.bankofscotland.co.uk/mortgages.html)[[4]](https://www.barclays.co.uk/business-banking/borrow/commercial-mortgages/#:~:text=A%20commercial%20mortgage%20is%20a%20type%20of,Buying%20motor%20vehicles%2C%20machinery%20and%20other%20equipment)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PKe7_9VlNtU&t=233)[[6]](https://www.rbs.co.uk/business/loans-and-finance/commercial-mortgage.html)[[7]](https://www.santander.co.uk/corporate/solutions/finance/commercial-mortgage)

**How to Apply** 

1. **Broker Consultation:** Many, including [Atom bank](https://www.atombank.co.uk/business-loans/commercial-mortgages/) , recommend speaking to an independent broker to assess needs.
2. **Documentation:** Prepare business plans, proof of income, and details of the property.
3. **Valuation:** The lender will conduct a valuation on the security property.
4. **Approval & Terms:** The lender will provide a decision based on credit history and the property's value.[[1]](https://developmentbank.wales/get-business-finance/property-development-loans/commercial-property-loans)[[2]](https://www.atombank.co.uk/business-loans/commercial-mortgages/)[[3]](https://togethermoney.com/commercial-mortgages)

**Alternatives & Considerations** 

- **Development Finance:** For building projects, such as those covered by the [Development Bank of Wales](https://developmentbank.wales/get-business-finance/property-development-loans/commercial-property-loans) , specialist funding is available.
- **Rates:** Commercial interest rates often vary from 7.5% to 18% per annum.
- **Risk:** As a secured loan, the property may be repossessed if repayments are not made.[[1]](https://developmentbank.wales/get-business-finance/property-development-loans/commercial-property-loans)[[2]](https://www.bajajfinserv.in/commercial-property-loan-interest-rates#:~:text=Table_title:%20Commercial%20property%20interest%20rates%20Table_content:%20header:,of%20Interest%29%20%28Floating%20rate%20of%20interest%29%20%7C)[[3]](https://www.natwest.com/business/loans-and-finance/commercial-buy-to-let-mortgages.html)
